svg.title: Pet Owner revised activity diagram
svg.desc: Current iPawcus workflow, reviewed 19 October 2026. Alternative activity branches use decisions and merges; actor labels identify responsibility.
svg.text: Register / verify email, or sign in
with password or linked Google account
email verification, token, and role access
load own pets and permitted tools
Add/edit a pet, link a shareable ID,
refresh My Pets and pet profile
while on the allowed clinic network
request an email copy if needed
If linking Google: verify a matching
Pets, appointments, clinic queue, records, medication checklists, and personal tools
Current local implementation reviewed: 19 October 2026 | Rounded box: activity | Diamond: decision / merge | Small label: responsible actor
Columns are alternative work areas. Merge diamonds combine alternatives; they do not wait for every activity to finish. Pending reviews may be revisited later.
Use the selected action's validation rules. For a timeout or uncertain write result, refresh the record before resubmitting. Leaving an activity returns to the menu.
Booking route depends on the selected service. Routine grooming and Pet Hotel do not require the clinical queue/diagnosis sequence.
Proof submission is not verified payment. An online call becomes joinable when the assigned veterinarian marks it ready.
Only owned/co-owned pets and owner-visible medical content are available. Prescription checklist entries record reported use.
